title: Proofbench Readiness Manifest
description: Schema for ready.yaml: the per-repo declarative spec of how a service becomes runnable and testable on any substrate. Derive, don't restate — points into existing truth (compose files, devcontainer.json, Makefile, AGENTS.md). All types derive from internal/manifest/types.go.

service.description: Short identifier for this service (e.g. 'orders-api'). Used as a key in workspace.yaml and as a human-readable label.

role.description: One-sentence description of what this service does (e.g. 'REST API for order lifecycle'). Aids auto-generated documentation.

sources.description: Map of source-type name to file path for existing project files the harness should read instead of duplicating. Common keys: compose, devcontainer, agentsmd. The harness derives deps, healthchecks, and env from these files.

additionalProperties.description: Relative path from the repo root to the source file.

run.description: Declares the supported run modes and how to start and probe the service.

resources.description: Map of resource name to Score-style typed dependency. Resources are resolved per substrate via their 'via' map. Use '${resources.<name>.host}' placeholders in env overrides.

seed.description: Ordered list of seed steps (schema migrations, fixture loading) that prepare the service's data layer. Steps are run in order, after their 'after' dependencies are satisfied.

drive.description: Map of verb name to real product entrypoints the harness may exercise. Drive verbs run actual product paths, not test look-alikes.

checks.description: Ordered list of declared validation surfaces. Each check names the proof-ladder level it proves and the predicates that must hold.

gates.description: Human gates on destructive or irreversible steps (e.g. cluster deploys, prod writes). A gate blocks the step until approved; an unapproved gate yields 'inconclusive', never a fake pass.

known_walls.description: Known failure traps for this service: symptom, root cause, and recovery recipe. Agents and humans consult these before debugging.

RunSpec.title: RunSpec
RunSpec.description: Supported run modes and the start/probe recipe for each. 'modes' lists the substrates this service can run on; 'local' provides the bare-process recipe; 'ready' is the readiness probe.

modes.description: Substrates this service supports. At least one required. Values: local (bare process), compose (Docker Compose), k8s-attach (BYOC port-forward), remote (delegate to provider).

local.description: Bare-process (local substrate) start recipe. Required when 'local' appears in modes.

ready.description: Readiness probe using k8s probe vocabulary. The harness polls this until the service reports healthy or the timeout expires.

LocalRun.title: LocalRun
LocalRun.description: How to start the service as a bare process on the local substrate.

start.description: Shell command to start the service (e.g. 'npm run dev', 'go run ./cmd/server'). Runs in the repo root.

EnvSpec.title: EnvSpec
EnvSpec.description: Sources environment variables from an optional file, with explicit overrides. Overrides may use '${resources.<name>.host}' placeholders resolved per substrate.

file.description: Relative path to a .env-style file whose variables are loaded into the process environment (e.g. '.env.local').

overrides.description: Key-value overrides applied after the file is loaded. Values may reference Score-style resource placeholders (e.g. '${resources.db.host}').

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description: Readiness probe using k8s probe vocabulary. Specify exactly one of http, tcp, or exec.

http.description: HTTP GET target in ':port/path' or 'host:port/path' form (e.g. ':8080/healthz'). The harness polls until it gets a 2xx response.

tcp.description: TCP dial target in ':port' or 'host:port' form. The harness polls until the connection succeeds.

exec.description: Shell command whose exit code 0 signals readiness (e.g. 'pg_isready -h localhost').

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for readiness in Go duration syntax (e.g. '60s', '2m'). Defaults to 60s if omitted.

interval.description: How often to poll the probe in Go duration syntax (e.g. '2s'). Defaults to 2s if omitted.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: A Score-style typed dependency (database, queue, service). The 'via' map resolves the locator per substrate name. Placeholder '${resources.<name>.host}' is available in env overrides.

type.description: Semantic resource type (e.g. 'postgres', 'kafka', 'redis', 'service'). The harness uses this to apply substrate-specific defaults.

via.description: Map of substrate name to locator string for this resource on that substrate (e.g. {'compose': 'postgres', 'k8s': 'svc/orders-db'}).

optional.description: If true, the harness skips this resource when unavailable instead of failing the run. Defaults to false.

repo.description: For type 'service': relative or absolute path to the dependency's repo root, used when the harness needs to bring up the dependency locally.

SeedStep.title: SeedStep
SeedStep.description: One seed task (schema migration, fixture load, data initialisation) with an explicit dependency ordering.

name.description: Unique name for this seed step within the manifest, used as a dependency reference in other steps' 'after' lists.

run.description: Shell command to execute (e.g. 'npm run db:migrate'). Runs in the repo root.

after.description: Names of seed steps or resource names that must complete successfully before this step runs.

DriveVerb.title: DriveVerb
DriveVerb.description: A real product entrypoint the harness may invoke. Drive verbs exercise actual product paths (not test look-alikes) and may inject identity credentials.

run.description: Shell command to invoke the entrypoint (e.g. './scripts/create-order.sh'). Runs in the repo root.

identity.description: Identity injection recipe. 'env:VAR_NAME' reads from an environment variable; other forms TBD.

output.description: Expected output format of the command for structured parsing (e.g. 'json', 'text').

CheckSpec.title: CheckSpec
CheckSpec.description: A declared validation surface: what to exercise, the proof-ladder level it proves, and the predicates that must hold. Results are captured in the evidence bundle's checks[] array.

name.description: Unique name for this check within the manifest. Must match the corresponding Check.name in the evidence bundle.

level.description: Proof-ladder rung this check proves when it passes. L0=static-valid, L1=builds/loads, L2=unit-green, L3=up+healthy, L4=effect-verified, L5=end-to-end observed.

exercise.description: What to run for this check: a drive verb reference (e.g. 'drive.create-order') or a shell command (e.g. 'playwright tests/e2e/order.spec.ts').

expect.description: List of predicate expressions that must all hold for the check to pass (e.g. 'exitCode == 0', 'http.status == 201', 'db.orders.rows > @before').

artifacts.description: Artifact types the harness should capture for this check (e.g. 'screenshot', 'trace').

Gate.title: Gate
Gate.description: A human gate on a destructive or irreversible step. An ungated destructive step must never execute autonomously.

on.description: The trigger event or action that requires human approval (e.g. 'deploy', 'drop-table', 'prod-write').

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this gate exists (e.g. 'cluster release is irreversible').

Wall.title: Wall
Wall.description: A known failure trap: observed symptom, root cause, and recovery recipe. Agents consult known_walls before spending time debugging.

symptom.description: Observable symptom string (error message, log line, or behavior) that signals this trap (e.g. '401 from artifact registry').

cause.description: Root cause of the symptom in plain language (e.g. 'token expiry').

recover.description: Shell command or step sequence to recover from this trap (e.g. 'gcloud auth print-access-token | docker login ...').
